title: OEDS Wind Turbine Power Curves
description: Power curves of about 400 wind turbine models from wind-turbine-models.com (power in kW over wind speed 1-21 m/s in 0.01 m/s steps).

list.name: t1
list.label: Turbine 1
list.query: SELECT column_name AS __text, column_name AS __value FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='windmodel' AND table_name='turbine_data' AND column_name <> 'wind_speed' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT column_name AS __text, column_name AS __value FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='windmodel' AND table_name='turbine_data' AND column_name <> 'wind_speed' ORDER BY 1

list.name: t2
list.label: Turbine 2
list.query: SELECT column_name AS __text, column_name AS __value FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='windmodel' AND table_name='turbine_data' AND column_name <> 'wind_speed' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT column_name AS __text, column_name AS __value FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='windmodel' AND table_name='turbine_data' AND column_name <> 'wind_speed' ORDER BY 1

list.name: t3
list.label: Turbine 3
list.query: SELECT column_name AS __text, column_name AS __value FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='windmodel' AND table_name='turbine_data' AND column_name <> 'wind_speed' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT column_name AS __text, column_name AS __value FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='windmodel' AND table_name='turbine_data' AND column_name <> 'wind_speed' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: windmodel.turbine_data
panels.description: Static power curve table: wind speed range, number of curve points and turbine models with a non-zero curve. No time dimension.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Curve points", min(wind_speed) AS "Min wind speed (m/s)", max(wind_speed) AS "Max wind speed (m/s)", (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT key AS turbine, max(value::float) AS rated, min(wind_speed) FILTER (WHERE value::float > 0.5) AS cut_in, max(wind_speed) FILTER (WHERE value::float > 0.5) AS cut_out FROM windmodel.turbine_data t, jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t) - 'wind_speed') GROUP BY key HAVING max(value::float) > 0) u) AS "Turbine models" FROM windmodel.turbine_data

panels.title: Largest and smallest turbine
panels.description: Largest rated power and the number of models above 3 MW and below 100 kW.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(rated)/1000 AS "Largest rated power", count(*) FILTER (WHERE rated > 3000) AS "Models above 3 MW", count(*) FILTER (WHERE rated < 100) AS "Models below 100 kW" FROM (SELECT key AS turbine, max(value::float) AS rated, min(wind_speed) FILTER (WHERE value::float > 0.5) AS cut_in, max(wind_speed) FILTER (WHERE value::float > 0.5) AS cut_out FROM windmodel.turbine_data t, jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t) - 'wind_speed') GROUP BY key HAVING max(value::float) > 0) u

panels.title: Power curves
panels.description: Curves are interpolated by the crawler (polynomial of order 3, negative values set to 0), so low-wind parts can show small artefacts, e.g. a few kW below the real cut-in speed. Wind speed is the x axis in m/s. Compare up to three models with the variables at the top. Rated power is reached at 10-14 m/s; the curve drops to 0 at the cut-out speed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT wind_speed AS "Wind speed (m/s)", (to_jsonb(t)->>'$t1')::float AS "$t1", (to_jsonb(t)->>'$t2')::float AS "$t2", (to_jsonb(t)->>'$t3')::float AS "$t3" FROM windmodel.turbine_data t ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Normalised power curves
panels.description: Power divided by the rated power of each model (maximum of the curve): shows the shape independent of size; low specific-power turbines reach rated power later but start producing earlier relative to their size.

targets.rawSql: SELECT wind_speed AS "Wind speed (m/s)", (to_jsonb(t)->>'$t1')::float / NULLIF((SELECT max(((to_jsonb(t)->>'$t1')::float)) FROM windmodel.turbine_data t), 0) AS "$t1", (to_jsonb(t)->>'$t2')::float / NULLIF((SELECT max(((to_jsonb(t)->>'$t2')::float)) FROM windmodel.turbine_data t), 0) AS "$t2", (to_jsonb(t)->>'$t3')::float / NULLIF((SELECT max(((to_jsonb(t)->>'$t3')::float)) FROM windmodel.turbine_data t), 0) AS "$t3" FROM windmodel.turbine_data t ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Capacity factor vs mean wind speed (Rayleigh)
panels.description: Estimated capacity factor if the wind follows a Rayleigh distribution (Weibull k=2) with the given annual mean wind speed at hub height, ignoring losses and air density. 7-8 m/s gives 30-45 % for modern turbines.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT wind_speed AS w, (to_jsonb(t)->>'$t1')::float AS v1, (to_jsonb(t)->>'$t2')::float AS v2, (to_jsonb(t)->>'$t3')::float AS v3 FROM windmodel.turbine_data t)
SELECT u AS "Mean wind speed (m/s)", sum(v1 * (pi()/2) * (w/(u*u)) * exp(-pi()/4 * power(w/u, 2))) * 0.01 / NULLIF(max(v1), 0) AS "$t1", sum(v2 * (pi()/2) * (w/(u*u)) * exp(-pi()/4 * power(w/u, 2))) * 0.01 / NULLIF(max(v2), 0) AS "$t2", sum(v3 * (pi()/2) * (w/(u*u)) * exp(-pi()/4 * power(w/u, 2))) * 0.01 / NULLIF(max(v3), 0) AS "$t3"
FROM c, generate_series(3, 11, 0.5) u GROUP BY u ORDER BY u

panels.title: Key data of the selected turbines
panels.description: Rated power, first wind speed with output (cut-in), last wind speed with output (cut-out) and power at 6, 8 and 10 m/s. Based on the curve (> 0.5 kW), not on manufacturer data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT k AS "Turbine", max(v) AS "Rated power (kW)", min(w) FILTER (WHERE v > 0.5) AS "Cut-in (m/s)", max(w) FILTER (WHERE v > 0.5) AS "Last output (m/s)", max(v) FILTER (WHERE abs(w-6) < 0.001) AS "At 6 m/s (kW)", max(v) FILTER (WHERE abs(w-8) < 0.001) AS "At 8 m/s (kW)", max(v) FILTER (WHERE abs(w-10) < 0.001) AS "At 10 m/s (kW)" FROM (SELECT '$t1' AS k, wind_speed AS w, (to_jsonb(t)->>'$t1')::float AS v FROM windmodel.turbine_data t UNION ALL SELECT '$t2' AS k, wind_speed AS w, (to_jsonb(t)->>'$t2')::float AS v FROM windmodel.turbine_data t UNION ALL SELECT '$t3' AS k, wind_speed AS w, (to_jsonb(t)->>'$t3')::float AS v FROM windmodel.turbine_data t) x GROUP BY k

panels.title: Rated power classes
panels.description: Number of turbine models per rated power class (maximum of the curve).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN rated < 100 THEN '1: <100 kW' WHEN rated < 500 THEN '2: 100-500 kW' WHEN rated < 1000 THEN '3: 0.5-1 MW' WHEN rated < 2000 THEN '4: 1-2 MW' WHEN rated < 3000 THEN '5: 2-3 MW' WHEN rated < 4000 THEN '6: 3-4 MW' WHEN rated < 6000 THEN '7: 4-6 MW' ELSE '8: >6 MW' END AS "Class", count(*) AS "Models" FROM (SELECT key AS turbine, max(value::float) AS rated, min(wind_speed) FILTER (WHERE value::float > 0.5) AS cut_in, max(wind_speed) FILTER (WHERE value::float > 0.5) AS cut_out FROM windmodel.turbine_data t, jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t) - 'wind_speed') GROUP BY key HAVING max(value::float) > 0) u GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cut-in wind speed
panels.description: Number of models by the lowest wind speed (m/s) at which the curve is above 0.5 kW. Resolution of the source curves is coarse (1 m/s), so most models start at 2-4 m/s.

targets.rawSql: SELECT lpad(floor(cut_in)::int::text, 2, '0') || ' m/s' AS "Cut-in", count(*) AS "Models" FROM (SELECT key AS turbine, max(value::float) AS rated, min(wind_speed) FILTER (WHERE value::float > 0.5) AS cut_in, max(wind_speed) FILTER (WHERE value::float > 0.5) AS cut_out FROM windmodel.turbine_data t, jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t) - 'wind_speed') GROUP BY key HAVING max(value::float) > 0) u WHERE cut_in IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Largest turbines
panels.description: The 15 models with the highest rated power (kW).

targets.rawSql: SELECT turbine AS "Turbine", rated AS "Rated power (kW)" FROM (SELECT key AS turbine, max(value::float) AS rated, min(wind_speed) FILTER (WHERE value::float > 0.5) AS cut_in, max(wind_speed) FILTER (WHERE value::float > 0.5) AS cut_out FROM windmodel.turbine_data t, jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t) - 'wind_speed') GROUP BY key HAVING max(value::float) > 0) u ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Rated power vs power at 8 m/s
panels.description: Each point is a turbine model: rated power (kW) against its power at 8 m/s. Points far below the diagonal trend have high rated wind speed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(v) AS "Rated power (kW)", max(v) FILTER (WHERE abs(wind_speed - 8) < 0.001) AS "Power at 8 m/s (kW)" FROM windmodel.turbine_data t, jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t) - 'wind_speed') AS j(k, val), LATERAL (SELECT val::float AS v) q GROUP BY k HAVING max(v) > 0

panels.title: Rated wind speed
panels.description: Number of models by the wind speed (m/s) at which the curve first reaches 95 % of the rated power; indicates the design wind class.

targets.rawSql: SELECT lpad(floor(w)::int::text, 2, '0') || ' m/s' AS "Rated wind speed", count(*) AS "Models" FROM (SELECT key, min(wind_speed) FILTER (WHERE value::float >= 0.95 * m) AS w FROM (SELECT t.wind_speed, j.key, j.value, max(j.value::float) OVER (PARTITION BY j.key) AS m FROM windmodel.turbine_data t, jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t) - 'wind_speed') j) z WHERE m > 0 GROUP BY key) y WHERE w IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
